lockMode.title: Lock
lockMode.description: For Email + password and Phone + password. Fixed: after the wrong passwords a method allows, a lock as long as its Lock for (minutes). Growing: after them, each further wrong password locks for twice as long, from 1 up to 60 minutes.

networkLimit.title: Tries per network and address per 15 minutes
networkLimit.description: 0: off. The right password clears them.

personalCheck.title: Refuse personal passwords
personalCheck.description: Refuses new passwords holding the name, the email address before the @, or a run of 4 keyboard or number steps (1234, qwer).
